statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations consistent with supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1)
The patient has episodes of dizziness (R42)
The patient had a recent event of syncope (R55)
The diagnosis codes I47.1, R42, and R55 were submitted
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
A 48-hour Holter monitoring study is medically necessary to correlate symptomatic episodes with potential arrhythmic activity and guide further management
